t: This is the Science Museum, on Exhibition Road in South Kensington. It was founded in 1857 and is one of London's major tourist attractions, with nearly 2.8 million visitors in 2025. The building was designed by Sir Richard Allison, a Scottish architect. He was associated with the government's Office of Works in London from 1889, and from 1914 he was its chief architect. So the museum's architect was a government man through and through.
